prompt: A crew records a follow-up inspection and recommends pruning the tree next month. What should it do about the orange clip?
promptZh: 巡護人員已記錄複查結果，並建議下個月修剪這棵樹。應如何處理橘色夾子？

options.text: Leave it until next month’s pruning is done.
options.zh: 等下個月修剪完成再取下。
options.whyZh: 夾子標記的是待複查，不是待修剪；無須留到後續作業完成。

options.text: Use it as the notice that the tree will be removed.
options.zh: 把它當作這棵樹將被移除的通知。
options.whyZh: 文中明確說明橘色夾子並非移除通知，複查也只建議修剪。

options.text: Remove it now that the follow-up has been recorded.
options.zh: 複查已記錄，現在就應取下。
options.whyZh: 複查結果登錄後就應取下夾子，即使後續還有修剪工作。

options.text: Remove it only if the report is changed to say no further work is needed.
options.zh: 只有把報告改成不需再作業才取下。
options.whyZh: 是否取下取決於複查是否已記錄，不取決於報告有無建議進一步作業。

explanationZh: 複查結果登錄後就應取下夾子，即使後續還有修剪工作。

vocabulary.note: 記錄複查與完成之後要做的工作，是兩個不同的時間點。

evidence: One reminder about the orange clips: crews use them to mark trees that need a follow-up inspection. A clip is not a removal notice. Please take a clip off after recording the follow-up, even if the report recommends that more work be done later.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: One reminder about the orange clips: crews use them to mark trees that need a follow-up inspection. A clip is not a removal notice. Please take a clip off after recording the follow-up, even if the report recommends that more work be done later.
